name: Pearl
description:
Pearl connects Claude to your own bank, card, loan, and investment accounts so you can ask real questions about your money and get real answers. Ask where your spending went last month, what subscriptions are charging you, how much is left in your grocery budget, what your debts are costing you, what your net worth is, how long your cash lasts, and whether you can afford what's coming up.

Pearl is personal finance for people whose finances aren't only personal. If you're self-employed, freelance, or running a small business, tag accounts and transactions as business or personal — business expenses on one side, household spending on the other. Useful at tax time, when deductible spending has to come apart from the rest, and for anyone tired of keeping two apps open.

Then set a target and work toward it. An emergency fund, paying off a card, a down payment: Pearl works out the monthly number, tracks progress against your real balances, and tells you when you're ahead or when the date is slipping.

Every answer is sourced. Pearl cites the accounts and transactions behind each number and tells you how fresh the data is, instead of guessing. You can clean up your data as you go — recategorize transactions, fix subscription and bill detection, set monthly budgets, adjust goals — and your corrections stick.

Accounts are linked through Plaid, scoped to your own account, and read on your behalf. Pearl helps you understand your money; it is not an investment adviser and does not tell you what securities to buy or sell.

Requires a Pearl account with an active subscription and at least one linked bank.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pearl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pearl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.joinpearlai.com/functions/v1/pearl_mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pearl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pearl lists 33 MCP tools, including annotate_transaction, calculate_average_surplus, calculate_debt_payoff, calculate_dti, calculate_goal_timeline, calculate_net_worth, calculate_runway, create_goal, create_recurring_bill, delete_recurring_bill, get_budgets, and get_cash_accounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pearl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pearl in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Pearl requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pearl is developed by Pearl Tech Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
